results.q: Son 30 günde toptan satış ne kadar?
results.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END) AS satis
FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (8)
  AND INVOICE.[DATE_] >= '2026-08-07' AND INVOICE.[DATE_] < '2026-09-07'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE -INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] END) AS net_ciro
FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01'

SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(INVOICE.[DATE_]), MONTH(INVOICE.[DATE_]), 1) AS ay, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE -INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] END) AS net_ciro
FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(INVOICE.[DATE_]), MONTH(INVOICE.[DATE_]), 1)
ORDER BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(INVOICE.[DATE_]), MONTH(INVOICE.[DATE_]), 1)

results.q: Perakende ile toptan satışları 2026 ay bazında karşılaştır
results.sql:
SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(INVOICE.[DATE_]), MONTH(INVOICE.[DATE_]), 1) AS ay, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS perakende_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (8) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS toptan_satis
FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8)
  AND INVOICE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(INVOICE.[DATE_]), MONTH(INVOICE.[DATE_]), 1)
ORDER BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(INVOICE.[DATE_]), MONTH(INVOICE.[DATE_]), 1)

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3) THEN STLINE.[AMOUNT] ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8) THEN STLINE.[AMOUNT] ELSE 0 END), 0) AS iade_oran
FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_STLINE] AS STLINE
WHERE STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0
  AND STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE.[DATE_] >= '2026-07-01' AND STLINE.[DATE_] < '2026-08-01'

SELECT CLCARD.[SPECODE2] AS kanal, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE -INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] END) AS net_ciro
FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE
JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_CLCARD] AS CLCARD ON INVOICE.[CLIENTREF] = CLCARD.[LOGICALREF]
WHERE INVOICE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
GROUP BY CLCARD.[SPECODE2]
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END) AS satis_tutar
FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7)
  AND INVOICE.[DATE_] >= '2026-08-01' AND INVOICE.[DATE_] < '2026-09-01'

SELECT 1 - SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8) AND STLINE.[OUTCOST] <> 0 THEN STLINE.[AMOUNT] * STLINE.[OUTCOST] ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8) AND STLINE.[OUTCOST] <> 0 THEN STLINE.[TOTAL] ELSE 0 END), 0) AS brut_kar_marj
FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_STLINE] AS STLINE
WHERE STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0
  AND STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND STLINE.[DATE_] < '2026-09-01'

SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(ORFICHE.[DATE_]), MONTH(ORFICHE.[DATE_]), 1) AS ay, COUNT(DISTINCT ORFICHE.[LOGICALREF]) AS siparis_sayi
FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_ORFICHE] AS ORFICHE
WHERE ORFICHE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND ORFICHE.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(ORFICHE.[DATE_]), MONTH(ORFICHE.[DATE_]), 1)
ORDER BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(ORFICHE.[DATE_]), MONTH(ORFICHE.[DATE_]), 1)

results.q: Perakende (TRCODE 7) ile toptan (TRCODE 8) satışları 2026 ay bazında karşılaştır: her ay için fatura sayısı, NETTOTAL toplamı ve ortalama fatura tutarı; ayrıca perakendenin o ayın toplam satışındaki payı.
results.sql:
SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(INVOICE.[DATE_]), MONTH(INVOICE.[DATE_]), 1) AS ay, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS perakende_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (8) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS toptan_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS perakende_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS trcode_7_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (8) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS trcode_8_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS perakende_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (8) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS toptan_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS perakende_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS trcode_7_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (8) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS trcode_8_satis
FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8)
  AND INVOICE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(INVOICE.[DATE_]), MONTH(INVOICE.[DATE_]), 1)
ORDER BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(INVOICE.[DATE_]), MONTH(INVOICE.[DATE_]), 1)
